scenes.heading: Where to find UGC brand deals

sents.d: Where to find UGC brand deals
Direct outreach and UGC-specific platforms both work — most creators use both.

UGC-specific marketplaces and platforms connect creators with brands actively looking for content, and are often the fastest way to land your first few paid deals while you're still building a reputation.

Direct outreach to brands you already like — a short pitch email with a specific content idea attached — tends to produce better long-term clients and often higher rates than marketplace listings, though it requires more upfront effort per lead.

Small and mid-size DTC (direct-to-consumer) brands are frequently more responsive to new creators than large established companies, since they typically have smaller budgets and are more open to testing new creator relationships.

take: Use marketplaces for first deals, then pitch brands directly.
